greeting: Welcome to The Sooty Hog! Best pork in the fire zone!
Room for rent, food for coin, and shade for the melting!
Hamhock's the name, hospitality's the game! Even in THIS heat!
Back for more of my famous Flame-Roasted Ribs? Knew you couldn't resist!
Pull up a chair! The floor's lava! ...Literally, in some spots. Watch your step.
Fresh from the road? You look COOKED! Ha! Fire jokes!
The Sooty Hog welcomes all! Even non-pork enthusiasts! We're inclusive!
I've got cold drinks! Well, lukewarm drinks. Everything's warm here.
dialog.room_offer: Got rooms with actual walls! Some even have doors! Luxury in Ember!
dialog.food_specialty: Try the Magma-Marinated Chops! Cooked by the ambient heat! Saves on firewood!
dialog.heat_complaint: Yes, it's hot. Yes, we deal with it. No, I don't know why we built an inn here. Ask my grandfather.
dialog.inn_history: The Sooty Hog's been here fifty years! Survived three eruptions, seven earthquakes, and one very persistent health inspector!
rumor: Heard there's a barrelgob collecting shiny things near the old mine. Careful, they bite!
Word from Tide says my cousin runs The Salty Sow. Rival inn! FAMILY rival inn!
The luchadors are at it again. Loud bunch. Good for business though!
Deep miners found something weird last week. Won't say what. Suspicious.
Mire's got an inn too. 'The Bogwater Bar.' Charming name. NOT.
dialog.salty_sow_rivalry: My cousin Brine runs The Salty Sow in Tide. Claims HIS inn is better. HAH! Does he have magma-heated floors? I THINK NOT!
dialog.travel_advice: Heading to Frost? Pack EVERYTHING warm you own. The cold bites harder than my ex-wife! And she had TEETH!
farewell: Sweet dreams! If you smell smoke, that's normal! Probably!
Come back soon! The fire's always burning! Literally!
Safe travels! Avoid the magma! Or don't! Your funeral!
Thanks for staying! Tell your friends! Tell strangers! Tell ANYONE!
dialog.time_dawn: Breakfast service! Charcoal-baked bread! Smoky flavor!
dialog.time_noon: Lunch rush! Everyone wants my Flame-Broiled Special!
dialog.time_dusk: Dinner crowd! The inn comes alive!
dialog.time_night: Late night service! For the nocturnal and the desperate!

party_reactions.kade: Another themed inn. This one's... very warm.
party_reactions.nix7: Ambient temperature: 38 degrees Celsius. Inn climate control: nonexistent.
party_reactions.korr: A roof is a roof. Even a hot one.
party_reactions.renna: Do you have any cooling enchantments? No? I'll manage.
party_reactions.suresh: Hospitality in hardship. There is nobility in that.
party_reactions.sova: Got a room with a view? Of... anything but lava?
party_reactions.grit: Reminds me of mess hall. Loud, hot, but the food's honest.
party_reactions.senna: The corners are shadowy. Good. I'll take that room.
party_reactions.callum: Is... is the floor supposed to be that warm?

relationship_dialog.stranger: Welcome, stranger! First drink's on the house! ...House is me. I'm the house.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Back again! Knew you'd love the Sooty Hog!
relationship_dialog.friend: My favorite guest! Your usual room's ready!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You! Family rates! Which means FREE! Don't tell my accountant!
